liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **T.C. plays Bach** (2 reviews): Brief snippet of Tom Constanten playing a J.S. Bach minuet, placed between Mama Tried and the Yellow Dog story; Tom Constanten says his piece on track 5 was the French Suite Allemande [9][17]
- **Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Not listed in DeadBase for the Thelma shows, so it may come from a different show [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **T.C. plays Bach**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Yellow Dog Joke**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd69-12-11.sbd-aud.cotsman.8998.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 30 songs; 199 min; rated 3.14/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Matrix is somewhat hissy but not bad compared with worse tapes [8]
- **gd69-12-11.sbd.gerland.10987.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 30 songs; 195 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard transfer sounds poor, so reviewer advises sampling tracks before downloading; Sound quality is very low overall, with Dark Star and Hard To Handle the exceptions; Reviewer calls it the worst-sounding soundboard they have heard, yet still pretty good [6][7][9]
- **gd1969-12-11.fob.brady.motb.91109.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 13 songs; 82 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [4]. Said about its sound: Sounds like a mono, single-mic recording, yet excellent; reviewer's best-sounding 1969 audience tape; Tape was stopped between every song, and Cold Rain And Snow cuts in abruptly at its opening notes [4][11]
- **gd1969-12-11.fob.brady.motb.91152.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 13 songs; 81 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [5]

## Around the show

- Constanten recalls that Stephen Stills sat in at this show [17]
- Reviewer prefers the Alligator>Caution from the 12th show as well worth hearing instead [7]
- Playing is less hard-hitting than some other 1969 shows, though still good [8]
- Compared with DeadBase, this looks like a composite of all three Thelma nights [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-12-11.sbd-aud.cotsman.8998.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul Bottiglio, Jack Warner, JCotsman; source: Soundboard and Audience Composite [1]. Also: A very good mono audience recording forms the main source of this soundboard-audience matrix [1]
- **gd69-12-11.sbd.gerland.10987.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dave Greenberg, Jack Warner, Scott Clugston, Jim Powell, Jay Gerland; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1969-12-11.fob.brady.motb.91109.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rion Brady; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe and MOTB; source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC [4]. Also: The MOTB source is mono; a synthesized stereo version also circulated via torrents; Dark Star cut at 19:59 was patched with about 33 seconds from the Gerland soundboard [4][15]
- **gd1969-12-11.fob.brady.motb.91152.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rion Brady; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe and MOTB; source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC [5]. Also: Synthesized stereo version made from the original mono source using Mid-Side processing; mono master is MOTB 0063; Tape stop/start interruptions between songs were crossfaded, and the Dark Star cut was patched from the Gerland soundboard [5]
